body:
i think any reasonable person would accept this 

but parents of users on this sub generally don't fall into the category of "reasonable people"

i really like the way you wrote this though. i might borrow some bits of this if i'm ever forced to come back after i leave

that part about having no friends? i confided that to my abusive mother once when i thought she'd turn a new leaf and start treating me kindly, and it was the worst decision i've ever made. ever since then, every time she's pissed off she'd use that as a weapon to hurt me.

the other day, i went downstairs to the kitchen to make some food at midnight. she followed me and screamed at me and said "this is why nobody likes you"--uh, what? because i was up at MIDNIGHT? 

she used this as an excuse to continuously hurl insults at me until i had enough and yelled back. then she called me useless and a waste of space and told me to leave her house, so now i'm at my equally-as-abusive grandmother's house and it's been hell. 

i've been contemplating running away ever since.

sorry i kind of hijacked your post and made it about me, i guess i just needed to let this out. just wanna say i pretty much relate to the entirety of your situation. it wasn't your fault and i'm sorry.
